findings.highlight: even I get captivated by her looks whenever I go out and fetch water from the well.
findings.evidenceJa: 井戸から水を汲む姿など、俺でも目を奪われるほどだ
findings.governingReading: The beautiful guest's appearance while drawing water captivates even Issei.
findings.explanation: The Japanese has Issei captivated by the woman drawing water. The English gives the water-fetching to Issei and reduces what he admires to her general looks.

findings.highlight: you're welcome to take my turn cooking tomorrow.
findings.evidenceJa: 明日からは藤村先生が代わってください
findings.governingReading: 明日からは代わってください requests ongoing substitution starting tomorrow, lending leverage against Taiga’s attempt to exclude her.
findings.explanation: Rin’s threat of Taiga replacing her from tomorrow onward becomes taking a single turn tomorrow.

findings.highlight: I don't like fried rice made from leftover rice
findings.evidenceJa: わたし炒飯は好きじゃないんだけど
findings.governingReading: 炒飯は好きじゃない states the general dish preference, with this mixed rice contrasted as exceptional.
findings.explanation: Rin’s dislike of fried rice gains a restriction to fried rice made from leftovers.

findings.highlight: instead of using bean curd, you mixed in yuzu citrus to make it aromatic.
findings.evidenceJa: 油物を混ぜるかわりに柚子で香りをとってる
findings.governingReading: 油物 identifies the oily/fatty food category being avoided when choosing yuzu aroma.

findings.highlight: some stranger who just barged into our lives
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日今日やってきた人にはあげないもん
findings.governingReading: 昨日今日やってきた人 specifies recency; it does not explicitly characterize hostile intrusion or strangerhood.
findings.explanation: Taiga’s refusal to share with a recent arrival becomes refusal to share with a stranger who barged into their lives.

findings.highlight: I felt a bit full, but it was fine after I finished eating it all.
findings.evidenceJa: 苦しかったけど、飲み込んじゃえばなんとかなるものよ
findings.governingReading: 飲み込んじゃえばなんとかなる sets swallowing as the workaround, prompting Shirou’s objection that this has no limit.
findings.explanation: Managing once food is swallowed becomes feeling fine after finishing the entire meal.
